messages.snippet: Dear Mr Ashworth, Execution version attached, dated for completion on 30 January with a Termination
messages.subject: Hollis — execution version for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Ashworth,

Execution version attached, dated for completion on 30 January with a Termination Date of 31 January 2026. It reflects all agreed terms: PILON £95,000, statutory redundancy £8,400, ex gratia £90,000, pro-rated bonus £14,250, costs contribution £750 plus VAT, six-month non-compete and the clawback at clause 3.5. Please arrange for your client to sign and for the adviser's certificate at Schedule 2 to be completed. We'll release funds within 28 days of receipt of the signed agreement.

Kind regards,
James Osei

James Osei
Senior Associate, Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
